jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- PMT Focal Point: Act as the primary point of contact responsibility for sub-areas of configuration management – from identification and change management (Change Control Boards) to the closure of configuration milestones – including managing the Z-MOD process (FTI change management) and maintaining the FTI configuration database (SABRE) in preparation for design.- Toolchain & ALM/PLM Integration: Manage and optimize the tool landscape and support rollouts as well as tool qualifications.- Compliance & Standards: Ensure that engineering methods and configuration processes comply with the strict regulatory requirements of the aviation industry.- industry.- In-depth knowledge of modern ALM, PLM, and systems engineering tools, as well as model-based systems engineering (MBSE) and requirements management.- Practical experience in configuration and change management in accordance with recognized standards.- Strong communication skills, diplomatic acumen at cross-functional interfaces, and a structured, solution-oriented, and proactive way of working.- Business fluent German and English skills, both spoken and written.- Nice to have: Good knowledge of data analytics, tool development and programming (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script).Not a
